# Upstream files we deliberately do NOT watch — for check-upstream.sh.
#
# Format: <upstream-path-relative-to-backend/>|<reason>
#
# EVERYTHING NOT LISTED HERE IS WATCHED. That direction is the point: a new
# upstream file — a new provider, a new feature — is reported the first time it
# changes, without anyone having to remember to add it to a list. Only the
# things we have decided to stop caring about need writing down, and each one
# is a decision with a date attached.
#
# This replaces .github/upstream-map.txt, which classified all ~46 upstream
# files and required a local path for each of the ~30 we did watch. Eight of
# those paths went stale the moment we deleted the code they pointed at, and
# reported "MAPPED changed, go look" at directories that no longer existed. An
# ignore list has nothing to rot: it names upstream files only.
#
# Before adding a line, be sure the reason is "we chose not to have this", not
# "we have not looked yet". The second is what the report is for.

# ── Providers delegated to the download engine (cleanup plan items 3–5) ──────
# We deleted our native implementations on purpose; the engine carries these
# now, with more routes and third-party maintenance. Porting upstream's work
# here would be undoing that decision.
amazon.go|native Amazon downloader deleted — engine-only provider
qobuz.go|native Qobuz downloader deleted — engine-only provider
qobuz_api.go|part of the deleted native Qobuz path
qobuz_community.go|part of the deleted native Qobuz path
tidal_community.go|Tidal community proxy fallback removed (item 10) — previews only, could never succeed

# ── The community-session plumbing those providers needed ───────────────────
community_apikey.go|backend/community deleted with the providers it served
community_endpoints.go|idem — and its AES-GCM encrypted proxy URLs are deliberately never decrypted
community_session.go|idem — the solver now answers the engine, not our Go
provider_endpoints.go|per-provider endpoint table for providers we no longer implement

# ── Cross-platform link resolution, removed with Song.link (item 7) ──────────
# The engine resolves from the Spotify URL internally, so cross-platform links
# stopped being something we need at all.
link_resolver.go|Song.link removed — engine resolves internally
songlink.go|idem
songstats.go|idem — one of the resolvers link_resolver orchestrated

# ── DRM ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
mp4ff_decrypt.go|Widevine/CENC decryption left with the native Amazon downloader; not reimplemented here

# ── Desktop-only (Wails) — never applicable to a web server ─────────────────
file_dialog.go|native file picker, desktop build only
fileicon_darwin.go|macOS icon extraction, desktop build only
fileicon_stub.go|build stub for the above

# ── Shipping ffmpeg, which a container does not do ──────────────────────────
# Upstream's ffmpeg.go downloads binaries from their own Dependencies releases
# and keeps them updated on the user's machine. Ours is a pinned BtbN build
# baked into the image at build time, verified against its published checksum
# (see engine/Dockerfile and docs/ffmpeg-runtime-regression.md). There is no
# version of this we would want.
ffmpeg.go|ffmpeg is baked into the image, not downloaded and updated at runtime
